sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports of slide builders and recipe schema
sections.what: Loads two slide builders, one for current recipes and one for older recipes, and the schema that checks recipe data.
sections.why: Two builders let old and new saved recipes each rebuild correctly.
sections.watch_out: Renaming either builder breaks the refresh.

sections.name: recipeCoverage
sections.title: Reading saved coverage numbers
sections.what: Reads the saved count of in-scope projects, the count processed and whether the list was cut short. It returns nothing if any count is missing or is not a whole number.
sections.why: Older saved runs may lack these numbers, so the code must cope without them.
sections.watch_out: Missing numbers return nothing, which drops the coverage line instead of reporting a failure.

sections.name: refreshLessonsRecipe
sections.title: Refreshing a saved recipe layout
sections.what: Rebuilds the slides of a saved recipe with current rules, keeps its research and coverage note, and updates the cover's generated-date line. Returns the recipe unchanged if its slides are already current.
sections.why: Lets users see current slide designs without re-running research.
sections.watch_out: The coverage note is found by matching its text, so the wording must stay the same.

summary: Rebuilds the slide layout of an old saved lessons recipe using current layout rules, without changing its research.
purpose: Lets older saved recipes display with the current slide design.
why: The comments say a layout refresh does not re-run research and does not make the research newly generated.
how: Checks the saved recipe's shape. If its slides are already current it returns the recipe unchanged. Otherwise it rebuilds the slides with the newer or legacy builder, depending on whether the facts were independently assessed. It keeps the executive coverage note when no new coverage is given and updates the cover's generated-date line.
inputs: A saved recipe object and optional coverage numbers.
outputs: A refreshed recipe object with new slides.
risks: Invalid input throws an error. The coverage note is found by its opening words, so changing that wording breaks the lookup. The refresh changes the parsed recipe it returns, so callers should use the returned value.
debug: If the executive summary has no coverage line, check the note wording and whether coverage was passed in. If slides look wrong, check whether the facts carry assessments. Invalid input errors come from the recipe schema.
